item.title: Version 0.9.2
item.description:
What's New

  • Wallpaper Automation is a full page with a playlist crate, day ring and shuffle deck, plus Single Wallpaper mode.
  • Playlists gain Auto-Advance and Loop; schedules support exact minutes and dragging across midnight.
  • Library shuffle gains exclusions, previous-wallpaper history and reshuffling. The clock gains a Split-Flap style.

Improvements

  • Wallpaper picking uses the in-page library with search and filters. Display controls, menus, contrast and translations are clearer.

Bug Fixes

  • Scene preset updates stay ordered; clearing a wallpaper preserves scene settings and reliably clears System Wallpaper.
  • Fixed display transitions, time-zone switching, shortcut labels and network readings; hardened file saves, invalid schedules and Pro scene data.
  • Fixed short schedule sections, shuffle counts and history, and keyboard interaction beneath information overlays.

Not notarized — if macOS refuses to open the app, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/Loomscreen Pro.app" once; updates Loomscreen Pro installs itself clear the flag. Full release notes · 完整发布说明
